title: KS-1669: May Renovate stay for the systemTest k6 pins, given your 'Dependabot, not Renovate' ruling?
bluf: A renovate.json sits at the repo root, last changed 2026-10-07 for the k6 pins (KS-1445/KS-1367). Your 2026-07-04 ruling (KS-352/353) was 'Dependabot, not Renovate', and the docs mention only Dependabot. The ticket proposes Renovate only for systemTest pins (everything outside Blockchain/Dev/**) with Dependabot kept for the platform. No change is proposed to the file yet; your answer decides KS-1446 too. Docs-only effect plus a keep/delete of one config file. Nobody outside the team sees the outcome.

sources.quote: renovate.json is tracked at the repo root. It was last changed 2026-10-07
Is Renovate allowed for the systemTest pins

options.label: Keep Renovate for systemTest pins only; Dependabot stays for the platform; docs say so
options.detail: Docs-only change recording the carve-out. renovate.json untouched. Also answers KS-1446 in principle (separate ticket decides base-image-watch.sh).

options.label: Delete renovate.json; Dependabot only (matches the 07-04 ruling literally)
options.detail: One file removed; k6/systemTest pin bumps then need a manual or Dependabot route. Docs unchanged.

default_action: After 48 h nothing changes: renovate.json stays as is and the docs stay silent about it (the status quo, fully reversible; equivalent to option a without the docs note).
